negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) The ramen was good. That's all. We ordered gyozas: they arrived cold. The service was very poor.

(Original)
El ramen estaba bueno. Nada más. Pedimos giosas: las trajeron frías. La atención fue muy deficiente

negative_reviews.author: Cheryl
negative_reviews.text: From their menu. "Regardless of ALLERGIES, food sensitivities, dietary requirements, or preferences, Maki and Ramen has you covered". Then in their FAQ section, there is a "potential for cross contamination". Carefully consider this before choosing to dine with us". A restaurant should not be heralding an ability to accommodate allergies as a marketing tool to gain business if they are not prepared to put the work in.
